name: Peping
story: Peping makes prebiotic fizzy drinks in cans and probiotic shots. The company is based in Bengaluru.

about.value: Peping is a Bengaluru drinks company, run by Peping Commerce Pvt. Ltd., that makes probiotic shots and prebiotic fizzy drinks.
It says its products are designed with a team of healthcare and nutrition professionals.
It describes its range as lower-sugar versions of everyday drinks.

name: Nuvie
story: Nuvie makes protein shakes and protein coffee that are lactose-free with no added sugar, and protein chocolate bars with no added sugar.

about.value: Nuvie is a brand of Nugain Wellness Pvt. Ltd., based in Bengaluru, making ready-to-drink protein shakes and protein bars.
The founders, both from a health and fitness background, say they started it to make food that tastes good and fits easily into daily life.
The brand says it makes its products for everyone, not only gym-goers, and plans to rework more everyday foods.

name: Farmley
story: Farmley makes dry fruit mixes, date bites, roasted makhana, seeds and berries.

about.value: Farmley is a snack brand of Connedit Business Solutions Private Limited, making dry fruit mixes, date bites, roasted makhana, seeds and berries.
It says it focuses on flavour, careful sourcing and clear labelling.
Its products are processed and packed at facilities in Indore, Madhya Pradesh and Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana.
